title: Preserve independent tap, slap and pop beat techniques
scope: Avoid the single SlapEffect projection for source combinations that can coexist, and emit supported beat techniques.
acceptance: Use distinct slap, pop and tap examples plus a supported combination from an independently read source.
Keep the already supported Tapped and LeftHandTapped note flags independent from beat technique state.
Define legacy enum edit authority and independently assert exported technique locations.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
Raw original/output consumer values and exact technique locations, including note independence.

resolution: Independent beat states and documented legacy reconciliation are implemented. All eight combinations and 32 beat/note combinations pass exact pinned consumer checks, including original GP3 and reordered combined GPIF sources. Explicit scoped reports cover required note flag additions, cleared beat conflicts and rest tap omission. Authored note flags remain unchanged. Awaiting fresh exact-commit review, integrated full gates and capability probe; issue remains open.
verification: Public legacy export regression failed before implementation and passes afterward.
Focused public, matrix, raw pinned-consumer and inventory checks pass; full gates and capability probe assigned to parent integration.
